channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: David Beckham's business reports record profits and dividends
item.description: David Beckham's business empire has reported record profits, with the former footballer receiving a dividend of $51 million (£39 million). This income is attributed to his involvement in approximately 12 brand advertising campaigns during… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Florida's Brightline Railway Files for Bankruptcy, Continues Operations
item.description: Brightline, a private equity-backed railway company operating high-speed trains in Florida, has filed for bankruptcy in court. The company is restructuring its debt as part of the bankruptcy proceedings. Despite the bankruptcy filing… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump, Xi Vie for Energy Supremacy Amid Shifting Gulf Oil Dynamics
item.description: Donald Trump and Xi Jinping are reportedly seeking to gain dominance in energy markets, coinciding with perceived shifts in the Gulf's oil cartel. The coverage suggests Trump aims to adopt strategies similar to those of the Biden… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: UK Windfall Tax Cut Could Cost Billions, Campaigners Warn
item.description: Campaigners have warned that an early scrapping of the UK's windfall tax could cost the country £8.6 billion by 2030. The tax, levied on the profits of oil and gas companies, was introduced to help mitigate the impact of high energy prices. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Americans' Economic Sentiment Remains Negative
item.description: Despite some potential improvements, Americans continue to hold a negative view of the economy, feeling worse about it than at nearly any point in modern history, according to CNN. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US Treasury Yields Hit Highest Level Since 2004 Amid Bond Selloff
item.description: The US bond market experienced its worst day since April 2025 on Wednesday, with the 30-year US Treasury yield surpassing 5.43%. This marked the highest level for the yield since 2004. The selloff in global bonds continued, keeping yields… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Prestige Estates launches major Bengaluru housing projects
item.description: Prestige Estates has launched two new residential projects in Bengaluru. One project, located in Devanahalli, is valued at Rs 1,750 crore. The company anticipates a total revenue of Rs 2,850 crore from these two new housing developments. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: JSW One Platforms files for Rs 3,054 crore IPO
item.description: JSW One Platforms, a B2B commerce player backed by Mitsui and Sajjan Jindal, has filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) to launch an Initial Public Offering (IPO). The issue… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Embassy REIT Raises ₹1,000 Crore in Bank Financing
item.description: Embassy REIT has raised ₹1,000 crores through the issuance of three-year floating-rate Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs). The financing was fully subscribed by a leading European multinational bank. This marks the first bank financing at… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Dabur India to acquire Ayurvedic brand Sesa Care after NCLT approval
item.description: Dabur India has received approval from the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) to merge its Ayurvedic hair-care brand Sesa Care into its portfolio. This move is intended to strengthen Dabur's premium Ayurvedic hair-care segment. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India and Australia Discuss Bilateral Investment Treaty
item.description: India and Australia are working on a bilateral investment treaty, according to Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal. Goyal also stated that the two countries should deepen mutual recognition for the seamless flow of Chartered Accountants (CAs). Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh mandates 70% renewable energy for data centers
item.description: Andhra Pradesh has set a rule requiring data centers to source 70% of their energy from renewable sources, while also addressing water concerns. Minister Lokesh stated that the state aims to establish Visakhapatnam as a significant… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Tesla Opens Sixth India Experience Centre in Chennai
item.description: Electric vehicle manufacturer Tesla has opened its sixth India Experience Centre in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. The company stated this expansion is part of its effort to build charging and service infrastructure across India, aiming to enhance… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Four Indian Companies Launch IPOs Seeking Over ₹1,700 Crore
item.description: Four initial public offerings (IPOs) opened for subscription on September 25, aiming to collectively raise ₹1,776 crore. The companies operate in diverse sectors including real estate, steel, networking, and digital commerce. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Rupee Fluctuates Against US Dollar Amid Oil Prices and Geopolitical Concerns
item.description: The Indian Rupee saw fluctuations against the US dollar in early trade, with one report stating it rose 14 paise to 95.85, while another reported a fall of 26 paise to 95.99. Forex traders cited persistent dollar demand from domestic… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: SEBI Approves Reforms Widening Investment Avenues and FPI Access
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) board has approved several reforms aimed at widening investment avenues and increasing Foreign Portfolio Investor (FPI) access. These reforms include allowing portfolio managers to invest… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Airlines Finalize Orders for Boeing 737 MAX Aircraft
item.description: Turkish Airlines has finalized an order for up to 150 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft. Separately, India's Akasa Air is reportedly in talks with Boeing to order 200 737 MAX aircraft. Details on a potential Bangladesh purchase of Boeing models were… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Make in India initiative marks 12 years amid mixed impact reports
item.description: The 'Make in India' initiative has completed 12 years. Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted the program's success, attributing national growth to infrastructure, enterprise, and innovation. He noted growth across various sectors… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: Canadian Dollar, Sterling Decline Against US Dollar
item.description: The Canadian dollar reached a two-month low following a monthly decline in retail sales. Separately, the British pound fell to its lowest point in nearly three months against the US dollar. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Barry Diller Withdraws $18 Billion Bid for MGM Resorts
item.description: Barry Diller has withdrawn his $18 billion bid to acquire MGM Resorts. Following the withdrawal of the bid, MGM Resorts' stock experienced a 10% decline. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Bond Yields Rise Amid Inflation Concerns, Affecting Markets
item.description: Bond yields are experiencing a sustained increase, driven by ongoing inflation fears that are keeping financial markets on edge. This rise in yields has led to a decline in stock prices, further exacerbated by higher oil prices. Financial… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 17 · Right 0.

item.title: US Treasury Yields Reach 2007 Highs, Worrying Investors
item.description: US Treasury yields have reached their highest levels since 2007, causing concern among investors. The rising bond rates are presenting a new challenge, with implications for the Federal Reserve. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Waaree Group enters specialty gases market for chip manufacturing
item.description: Waaree Group has entered the specialty gases market with its new venture aiming to become a one-stop supplier of ultra-high purity gases for chip fabrication plants. The company's shares were in focus following this announcement. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Adani Realty Plans Premium Housing Projects in Mumbai
item.description: Adani Realty is planning to launch premium and ultra-luxury residential projects in Mumbai. The company intends to develop these projects in Goregaon and Bandra, expanding its portfolio in the city and utilizing its land bank. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Maruti Suzuki commissions green hydrogen plant in Manesar
item.description: Maruti Suzuki India has commissioned its first green hydrogen plant at its Manesar facility in Haryana. The plant has a capacity of 300 kW. This initiative marks the company's move towards sustainable energy solutions. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Costco Reports Increased Profit and Revenue
item.description: Costco reported higher profits and revenue for its fourth quarter, driven by resilient consumer spending. The company exceeded sales estimates, with demand remaining strong for essential goods. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: US Restaurants Adjust Menus Amid Soaring Beef Prices
item.description: Amid rising beef prices, some US restaurants are altering their menus. A Texas smokehouse has removed brisket from its offerings, while McDonald's is focusing on chicken to boost sales in the US market. The fast-food chain aims to increase… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Adani Group to invest over ₹1 lakh crore in West Bengal by 2035
item.description: The Adani Group has announced plans to invest over ₹1 lakh crore (approximately $10.4 billion) in West Bengal by 2035. The investment will span across various sectors including ports, logistics, data centers, and power. Additionally, the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 2.

item.title: Insurance regulator's move triggers ₹1.12 lakh crore market cap loss
item.description: Indian financial stocks experienced a significant selloff on Thursday, resulting in a market capitalisation erosion of ₹1.12 lakh crore. The decline was attributed to proposed changes by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Vascon Engineers Wins ₹660.79 Crore Order from Qualcomm
item.description: Vascon Engineers has secured a contract worth ₹660.79 crore from Qualcomm for a project involving their Bengaluru office. Following the announcement, Vascon Engineers' shares experienced a significant increase, zooming by 14%. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian firm selected for major African project
item.description: An Indian-owned firm has been selected by Africa's richest man to undertake a $16 billion project. Separately, an Indian billionaire has hired a Chinese firm for a $498 million project in Zambia, which is set to become Africa's largest… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Oil Prices Dip Amid Hopes for US-Iran Diplomacy, Supply Concerns Remain
item.description: Oil prices experienced a slight decrease following a volatile week, with WTI crude at $93.52 a barrel and Brent crude at $105.80. This dip is attributed to optimism surrounding potential diplomatic solutions to the US-Iran conflict and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 7 · Right 2.

item.title: India and Kazakhstan Eye Deeper Trade and Investment Ties
item.description: India and Kazakhstan are seeking to strengthen their strategic partnership by fostering deeper trade and investment connections. Indian business organizations have welcomed the ratification of a free trade agreement with New Zealand… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Akamai and Anthropic Sign $11.6 Billion Cloud Services Deal
item.description: Akamai Technologies has signed a seven-year cloud services agreement with Anthropic valued at $11.6 billion. As part of the deal, Akamai will also grant Anthropic a warrant for up to a 5% stake in the company. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Tesla Begins Deliveries of Semi Electric Trucks, Opens Nevada Factory
item.description: Tesla has begun deliveries of its Semi electric trucks and opened a new factory in Nevada to scale production of the heavy-duty vehicles. The company is commencing deliveries of the Semi, an electric truck designed for heavy-duty transport. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sky TV announces content upgrade with JioHotstar integration
item.description: Sky TV has announced a significant upgrade for its Sky Q, Glass, and Stream boxes, integrating the JioHotstar content platform. This move will provide UK homes with access to more viewing options. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Argentina Poverty Rate Rises to 32.3% Under Milei
item.description: Argentina's poverty rate increased to 32.3% in the first half of 2026, up from 28.2% in the preceding six months, according to official data released on Thursday. Extreme poverty also rose to 7.5% from 6.3%. The data indicated that 44.5%… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Oracle Faces Claims Over Data Centre Payments
item.description: Oracle is facing scrutiny over its obligations to pay data centre investors, with questions arising about the company's ability to deliver on AI data centres. A 'force majeure' notice issued by Oracle has prompted these concerns. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.description: A global competition for critical minerals is intensifying, separate from major conflicts. The UN is assisting Nigeria, Guinea, and Zimbabwe, along with three other nations, in increasing the value derived from their critical mineral… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Global Food Prices Reach Three-Year High Amid Supply Shocks
item.description: Global food prices have risen to a three-year high, driven by climate shocks and the war in Ukraine which have tightened supplies. The Economic Times reported that these factors are contributing to the increase. Separately, the Evening… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
